readinessAlarmPayload.AlarmDescription: Readiness probe unsuccessful for 3 minutes. Continuous producer: in-process readiness publisher (READINESS_PROBE_INTERVAL_SECONDS). Triage: docs/production-observability.md#readiness-failure

organicEvaluation.description: Metric-driven readiness verdict using the same Minimum<1 / 3-datapoint rule as BaladiGuard-ReadinessFailure. Separate from SetAlarmState. Includes post-drill recovery samples so failure datapoints do not re-page.

snsDelivery.description: Forced SetAlarmState ALARM→OK to exercise AlarmActions/OKActions. Sanitized notification payloads prove the topic received both states.

alarmNotifications.newStateReason: Delivery drill: force ALARM to exercise SNS AlarmActions
alarmNotifications.subject: ALARM: BaladiGuard-ReadinessFailure

okNotifications.newStateReason: Delivery drill: force OK to exercise SNS OKActions
okNotifications.subject: OK: BaladiGuard-ReadinessFailure
